title: Agent
description: One agent: how it proves who it is, who owns it, and the most it may ever be granted. metadata.name is the agent's name. A task grant is the task type intersected with this document, never more.

owner.description: Who answers for this agent. For a service task, the owner is the accountable party in every record.

identities.description: How the agent proves who it is. The STS issues a grant only to a caller that presents one of these.

task_types.description: Task types this agent may run.

max_sensitivity.description: Highest tier of operation this agent may be granted.

max_ttl.description: Longest lifetime of any grant to this agent.

limits.description: Per-task ceilings: a task type's limit with the same name is capped at this max.

identity.description: One way the agent may authenticate. registration: the box's own one-time token at deploy, with the key made in the sidecar. jwt: a token with an issuer and a subject, which covers an identity provider's client, a Kubernetes service account, a cloud workload identity or a SPIFFE JWT-SVID.
